_comment: Cards and printings known to exist that the registry does not record, usually because the official API does not serve them. codex_id is the card a missing printing belongs to, or null when the card itself is unrecorded. Remove an entry once what it describes has a record. A listing or a report is a reason to go and look, not a record: see registry/notes.py.

gaps.name: The Champion
gaps.text: Printed for the Arthurian Legends store kit, the Organised Play prize support sent at the set's release, alongside the Frank Frazetta Sorcerer (P001640). Not served by the official API. Community reports disagree on the artist: Frank Frazetta or Vincent Pompetti.
